news.headline: Hegseth Said to Make Unannounced Visit to Israel for Talks With Netanyahu
news.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Israel’s defense minister, a week before a pivotal election.

news.headline: Exercise Keen Sword 2027 Begins in Japan
news.summary: Multilateral Exercise Keen Sword 2027 began on Ishigaki Island, Japan, involving about 45,000 Japan Self-Defense Forces troops, 11,000 U.S. service members and forces from Australia, Canada, France, Germany, the Netherlands, New Zealand and the Philippines.
